entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return. Order number is VF-881-2025-N.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull that up... VF-881-2025-N. I see an order for a Trailblazer helmet. Is that correct?
That's the one. Can I return it or not?
I can definitely check on that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's the wrong color. It's been sitting in the closet since we got it. The box is unopened. Just tell me yes or no.
Understood. One moment while I review the purchase date... Okay, I see it was delivered 58 days ago. According to our policy for standard items, you are well within the 90-day return window.

Yes, absolutely. Since the box is unopened, this is a straightforward return. Getting the right gear is important, especially for safety. I am processing the return authorization now and will email you a prepaid shipping label.
Good. Make sure it goes to the email on the account.
The label has just been sent. Simply print it, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at any carrier location. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
